description: Hide a comment from the public timeline, or bring it back. It is reversible and it is not a deletion — this server cannot delete anything. Not every network can do it: LinkedIn has no hide at all. Call get_social_capabilities to check first.

hidden.description: true hides it, false brings it back.

social_network.description: The comment's network, as list_comments reported it. Optional, but with it the call fails immediately on a network that has no hide, instead of travelling to PlanVortex to find out.

name: hide_comment
title: Hide or unhide a comment
